title: Aldeia da Mata parish
sampling: DGT viewer hierarchy levels 1–3 across 60 intersecting tiles, ground returns aggregated in parish grid cells.
method: Class 2 returns from viewer hierarchy levels 1–3 averaged into 4 m cells. Empty cells filled from nearest measured cell. Gaussian smoothing sigma 2 m. Cells farther than 16 m from measurements omitted. Grid clipped by cell centres to CAOP2025 parish polygon. Return count sums measurements in cells whose centres are inside that polygon. Heights stored at 1 cm quantization. 8 m mesh vertices with 4 m grid lighting.
